township_range_section: SW¼ sec.26, T.39 N., R.2 W.
notes: Sampled table is 'Monthly and yearly discharge, in acre-feet'. Monthly cells: water year 1955 has 8 (Feb.-Sept.; Oct.-Jan. are dashes), 1956-59 have 12 each = 56. 'The year' column: 4 values (1955 is a dash), counted as summary values. Variable written as runoff because the values are volumes in acre-feet, though the title says 'discharge'; rules do not say which word to use here. Start date is the first printed month (Feb. 1955) although 'Records available' says January 1955. Other location words: on right bank 500 ft downstream from Fan Gulch, 900 ft upstream from mouth, and 6 miles southeast of McCloud.
